payload.title: Account selection: papyrus accounts / account use, X-Prospectus-Account header, console chooser persisted and sent
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. The selected Account travels with every call as a choice, never a credential; the server authorizes it (next task). Ready now.

## CLI
- `src/papyrus_content/cli_user_auth.py`: `papyrus accounts` lists the person's entitled accounts from the site (`GET /cli/accounts` route below) as a table (name, id's last 4 characters, role); `papyrus login --account <id|name>` and `papyrus account use <id|name>` store `accountId` in `user-session.json`; when the person has exactly one account it is selected automatically; with several and none selected, account-scoped commands stop with "Choose an account: papyrus account use <name>". `selected_headers(endpoint)` (~347) adds `X-Prospectus-Account: <uuid>` when set. `papyrus account` (no args) prints the selection.
- `docs/cli-login.md` "Accounts".

## Site routes
- `app/cli/accounts/route.ts`: `GET` with the bearer access token -> `GET /v1/accounts` as the site role with `X-Prospectus-Human-Token`; returns `[{id, name, role}]`; passes `401/403 reenrollment_required` through unchanged.

## Console
- `components/prospectus-account-chooser.tsx` already chooses; persist the choice per site in `localStorage` key `papyrus.account` and send `X-Prospectus-Account` on every GraphQL call from the console's client (find the Amplify client configuration, likely `lib/amplify-client.ts` or where `generateClient` is called, and add a request header hook; AppSync forwards request headers to resolvers as `ctx.request.headers`). The chooser is a row of buttons, not a dropdown (Lucide `building-2` icon + name); the current account is named in the header text, "Account", never "Organization".
- When the person has one account, no chooser is shown.

## Gherkin (`features_backend/cli-account-selection.feature`, `features/console-account-selection.feature`)
  Scenario: A person with one account has it selected without asking
  Scenario: A person with several accounts must choose before an account-scoped command runs
  Scenario: The selected account is sent as X-Prospectus-Account on every call
  Scenario: The console remembers the chosen account per site and sends it
  Scenario: Listing accounts passes reenrollment_required through to the CLI

## Acceptance
CLI tests (`src/papyrus_content/tests/` pattern), route tests, Playwright feature for the chooser; no ids in fixtures (synthetic UUIDs are fine, named as such). Ready now; shares `cli_user_auth.py` with the enrollment task, so land enrollment first or coordinate.
